headline: DEFENSE PRESSES OTF JAM
body: Lil Durk's defense challenged Kacey ‘OTF Jam’ Hester over answers attorney Brian Steel said shifted during a five-hour recorded interview. Durk has pleaded not guilty; the federal trial continues.
caption:
Lil Durk's defense challenged Kacey ‘OTF Jam’ Hester over answers attorney Brian Steel said shifted during a five-hour recorded interview. Durk has pleaded not guilty; the federal trial continues.

Lil Durk (@lildurk) is on trial in Los Angeles on federal murder-for-hire charges. During Friday's cross-examination, Steel pressed Hester about what the defense characterized as inconsistencies in his account. Hester disputed that characterization and distinguished private conversations from group discussions. The jury will decide what weight to give the testimony.

Sources: DancehallMag, Aug. 29, 2026; Los Angeles Times, Aug. 24, 2026. Original editorial illustration by RapWire 24/7.
